scope: Host Mesa GLV14/RTV4 replay of two independently public-sampled black strokes on a 192x192 opaque patterned prior; controlled host draw, not Android or saved-note parity.
inputs: First pressure_ramp, then channel_baseline (constant 0.5 pressure), from pencil2-v14-native.json; identical points and sizes. RT_UPDATE is called for each stream.
translation: Bottom-left scale 1; ramp [6,9], baseline [9,11] framebuffer pixels.
canvas_svg_wasm: Complete RGBA frames match native exactly.
pdf_method: SVG-page and direct canvas PDFs rendered at 72 DPI and compared to native RGB by overlap_pdf_compare.py.
environment: See overlap-capture-info.json for GL, DSO, and source pins.
